items.stem: Which setting ensures a numeric answer falls within an allowed range before submission?

options.rationale: Correct: response validation enforces rules such as a number range.
The confirmation shows after submission; it does not validate input.
Linking stores responses; it does not validate them.

items.explanation: Correct: response validation enforces rules such as a number range.

items.stem: You want respondents who answer 'No' to skip a whole section. Which feature do you use?

options.rationale: Correct: section branching routes respondents based on their answer.
Required only forces an answer; it does not route.
Answer keys grade; they do not branch navigation.

items.explanation: Correct: section branching routes respondents based on their answer.

items.stem: Which TWO practices support responsible data collection in a form? (Select TWO.)

options.text: State the purpose and obtain consent when collecting personal data
options.rationale: Correct: stating purpose and consent is responsible practice.

options.text: Use clear labels so questions are accessible
options.rationale: Correct: accessible labels help all respondents answer correctly.

options.text: Collect personal data without explaining why
options.rationale: Collecting without purpose or consent is poor practice.

options.text: Rely on auto-grading for free-text opinions
options.rationale: Free-text opinions cannot be reliably auto-graded.

items.explanation: Correct: stating purpose/consent and using accessible labels are both responsible practices.
